property_summary: Deposits into an account must accumulate additively regardless of entry path: after a direct Put of v1 and an ETH transfer of v2 that triggers the fallback Put, Acc[actor].balance must equal v1+v2, but the mutant overwrites the balance with the last msg.value so it is only v2.
change_summary: Replace the balance accumulation with an assignment that overwrites the balance with msg.value.
